**STEP 3 - Items:** Cheese pizza slice (lower left), white rice (centre-right), Brussels sprout halves with dark glaze (upper right), yellow potato pieces (right), a few small green vegetable pieces and a dark leaf (scattered). No visible oil pool.

**STEP 7 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 261 g and ≈ 340 kcal. This fits a single plate of this size with a pizza slice and a moderate portion of rice and vegetables. The pizza is a partial slice, so I kept its weight modest. The estimate is plausible.
